Tax Disputes: When Should A Taxpayer Seek Ministerial Relief Or Turn To Judicial Review?

When faced with an adverse tax position, taxpayers may have more than one avenue available to them. The conventional route is familiar: challenge the assessment through the statutory appeal process.
